notes:
ACCESS. The prior Home-Decor pass recorded this site as a hard DataDome block on every route. Re-tested from scratch and the picture has changed only partly: a curl_cffi profile sweep now returns HTTP 200 on the HOMEPAGE for several fingerprints (chrome116/124/131/136, safari17_0, safari18_0_ios, safari17_2_ios, firefox133) while chrome110/120, safari15_5, safari18_0, edge99/101 and chrome99_android still 403. Every /c/ CATEGORY listing URL still 403s on all of those profiles, and so do r.jina.ai (Cloudflare challenge on the reader's own worker), translate.goog (it reaches the real origin and receives the identical DataDome interstitial), the site's own BFF host bff-www.maisonsdumonde.com/api, and the FR sitemap_index.xml. The route that DID work is a real Chrome session (claude-in-chrome): loading the homepage in the browser lets Chrome solve DataDome's JS challenge and mint a valid clearance cookie, after which same-origin fetch() calls issued from the page context return the genuine server-rendered category HTML at HTTP 200. All 91 category pages behind this result were read that way. DataDome rate-limits bursts - an unthrottled run of 12 fetches got the session 403'd for several minutes - so the harvest was paced at roughly one request per 7-8 seconds with retry and backoff. Every one of the 91 pages finished at HTTP 200; none were left unread and no row here rests on an unverified page.

ROBOTS. robots.txt does name Claude explicitly: 'Anthropic-ai', 'ClaudeBot' and 'Claude-Web' sit in a shared user-agent group with GPTBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot and others. That group is NOT a blanket 'Disallow: /'. Its rules are /*/*/p/*-M2*.htm, /*/compte/*, /*/commande/*, /*/search/, /*?ref=*, /*?variant=*, /*?viewType=*, /*/q/, /*query=*, */m/*page=* and /*/login?* - account, checkout, on-site search and query-string URLs, essentially the same set the '*' group receives. The /FR/fr/c/ category listing pages used here are NOT disallowed for ClaudeBot. This is therefore not the Claude-specific content block the brief says to stop for (unlike madeindesign.com and home24.de). Only allowed paths were fetched: no /search/, no /q/ and no query-string listing URL was requested at any point.

TREE. Built from the site's own mega-menu, which is server-rendered into every category page and expands whichever department you are currently inside. Five department pages were fetched to expand all five furniture-bearing menus: Meubles, Canapes et fauteuils, Jardin, Literie and Meubles et Deco enfant. Node names were translated to plain-ASCII English per the brief (Canapes to Sofas, Fauteuils to Armchairs, Tables basses to Coffee Tables, Buffets to Sideboards, Armoires to Wardrobes, Chevets to Bedside Tables and so on); no French is retained anywhere, including in flags.

QTY. Method 1 throughout - the site's own rendered listing header 'N articles'. Confirmed that the number present in the server-rendered HTML is the same number the browser paints: Vaisseliers showed 213 in the live rendered DOM and 213 in the fetched HTML; Canapes droits showed 6893 both ways. No structured-JSON source and no tile counting was used for any row.

SANITY CHECKS. (a) Discrimination - the number changes per category (Vaisseliers 213, Tabourets 588, Canapes droits 6893), so it is not a site-wide constant. (b) h1 match - every fetched page's h1 was captured and matched the category requested, ruling out silent parent substitution. (c) Drift - Buffets, Armoires, Lits and Tables de jardin were re-read later in the session and returned identical numbers (3410, 923, 7809, 1352). (d) No suspiciously round display caps. (e) No parent total was ever reused for a child; parents are emitted as grouping rows with qty null. The counts are large because this is a marketplace, and its children overlap - a convertible corner sofa is listed in both Canapes convertibles and Canapes d'angle - so children over-sum their parent (the Canapes children total 21061 against the Canapes node's own 14505). That is the site's own behaviour, not an extraction error, and no row here was produced by summing anything.

DEDUPED. 'Fauteuils' (slug fauteuils-a3fc1b72...) is linked from both Canapes et fauteuils and Meubles > Meubles de salon; it is emitted once, as Armchairs. 'Bouts de lit' is linked from both Meubles > Meubles de chambre and Literie; it is emitted once, under Bedroom Furniture.

EXCLUDED and why. Vasques (wash basins) and Saunas et Spas - bathroom and leisure fixtures, not furniture. Rangements exterieur (355) - opened it and the tiles are garden storage chests and boxes, i.e. standalone storage goods, so out per the storage-versus-furniture line. Housses de protection - furniture covers. Abris de jardin, Pergolas et tonnelles, Parasols, Voiles d'ombrage, Barbecues et planchas and Braseros - garden structures and cooking or heating equipment. Matelas, Sommiers, Ensemble matelas et sommiers, Surmatelas, Couettes, Oreillers, Aleses, Accessoires literie, Matelas bebe et enfant and Matelas de sol enfant - mattresses and bedding. Parcs bebe (playpens), Transats bebe (bouncers) and Sacs et matelas a langer - baby equipment. Boites et paniers de rangements enfant - storage baskets. Portemanteaux et pateres enfant and Tipis enfant - wall hooks and play tents. The whole of Deco, Luminaires, Linge de maison et tapis, Arts de la table, Petit electromenager, Animalerie, Decoration de jardin and Papiers peints - other departments. 'Bar et chaises hautes pour professionnels' (37) - a curated pro-collection landing page, excluded as a Collection per the never-extract list, and its products duplicate Chaises et tabourets de bar anyway. Ventes flash, Braderie, Seconde Chance, Best-sellers, Nouveautes, every Cadeaux gift node, the Rhinov decorator service page, and the ?f= / ?bra= / ?st= material- and brand-filter re-cuts of the Meubles listing (Meubles Rotin, Meubles Industriel, Meubles Zago, Meubles Tikamoon, Meubles Metal, Meubles Cannage) - all promotional, filter or collection pages.

ONE KNOWN GAP. The category-facet chip row on the Canapes pages shows a sibling 'Canapes panoramiques' that never appears in the mega-menu and for which no /c/ slug is exposed anywhere in the rendered navigation, so it could not be opened or counted and is deliberately not emitted.
